**Yes.** The evidence indicates that approximately **0.5 hectares of mapped native forest** experienced tree-cover loss in 2022.

The detected loss event covered 0.6 hectares in total, or 3.41% of the property. All of the event area was mapped as forest in the 2020 JRC reference; the national forest map classified 0.5 hectares as native forest and 0.1 hectares as outside mapped forest.

A further 0.2 hectares of loss occurred in patches below the 0.5-hectare event threshold and was not counted as an event. The evidence identifies tree-cover loss, but does not establish its cause.
